schema.title: Response Approve Artifact Version Artifacts  Artifact Id  Versions  Version  Approve Post

post.description:
Generate a capability or workflow from a natural-language intent.

RiteSmith automatically decides whether to produce a Lua script or a Trama
workflow based on intent analysis — the caller does not need to specify a type.

get.description:
Returns how many persisted Lua artifacts still use home.* functions.

When pending == 0, the home.* provider can be removed.
